resources.string: Personal Steam session and game-presence controller
Sign in by scanning a QR code with the official Steam Mobile app on another device (a second phone or tablet). IdleGamer never asks for your password or Steam Guard codes.

Steam only accepts this code from the camera scanner in the Steam Mobile app, so it cannot be approved on the phone that shows it. Use Steam Mobile signed in to your account on another phone or tablet.
From another phone or tablet with Steam Mobile: tap the shield (Steam Guard) → \"Scan a QR code\", then approve the sign-in for \"%1$s\".
This code signs in whoever approves it. Approve it only because you pressed \"Sign in\" here. Never scan or approve a QR code someone sent you.
Approved. Signing in and verifying the account…

IdleGamer is an unofficial Steam client. Valve does not support it and may change the protocol at any time. Using game presence without actually playing can violate the Steam Subscriber Agreement (§4.C) and may lead to account restrictions. Use a test account first.
Steam no longer accepts the saved session. Please sign in again.

This session was revoked (for example via \"Deauthorize all devices\"). Please sign in again.

Notifications are disabled: the Stop button will not appear in the notification shade.
Presence sent on a live connection

• Game presence tells Steam you are playing without running the game.
• The Steam Subscriber Agreement (§4.C) prohibits faking gameplay statistics, including playtime, and earning rewards without genuine input. Valve may restrict or terminate accounts without notice.
• IdleGamer cannot verify that Steam counts any time. The local timer is not proof.
• Friends see you as "in game".

You alone decide whether to use this on your account.
I understand and accept these risks for my own account
Your library is empty. Pull to refresh or add an App ID manually.
No games match the current search or filter.

Library has not been loaded from Steam yet.
For technical testing. IdleGamer does not verify that you own this app.
Verification re-reads playtime_forever from Steam. Steam updates it with a delay; an unchanged value does not prove anything either way.
Durations are local measurements of live presence time. They are not Steam playtime.
interrupted (app was killed); time counted up to last checkpoint
Log out and delete the saved session from this device? IdleGamer will also ask Steam to revoke it.
Logged out. Steam confirmed the session was revoked.
Logged out and deleted locally. Steam did not confirm revocation; revoke it manually (see below).
Steam → Settings → Security (or store.steampowered.com/twofactor/manage) → \"Deauthorize all other devices\". This signs out every device except the one you use, including IdleGamer.
The ongoing notification shows status and a Stop button while a session runs.
Keep CPU awake while presence is active
Uses a partial wake lock (renewed hourly, released on Stop). Improves reliability with the screen off but drains the battery.
Protects the UI only (biometrics or screen lock). It does not encrypt anything further and does not affect the background session.
No biometric or screen lock is set up on this device.
Clear session history and event log
Delete this data from the device?
Creates a text report of recent events. Tokens and codes are redacted and the SteamID is shortened. Nothing is sent unless you choose where to share it.
Personal project. Not affiliated with Valve. No servers, analytics or ads: everything stays on this device except the connection to Steam.
